stages.attempt: A student calls every thick-centred transparent object converging. Explain why a biconvex element immersed in an index-matched liquid need not converge.
stages.reconstruct: With equal indices no bending at interfaces, so no lens power even with curved surfaces. Convergence requires relative index and suitable shape.
